evaluation_contract.test_evaluation: deterministic report-only replay over the complete test split after the training target is reached
evaluation_contract.train_evaluation: deterministic replay over the complete train split after the training target is reached

evidence_scope_limit: This audit establishes the available calendar/session length and configured nominal transition budget. It does not establish actual episode-by-episode full-year traversal, because episodes may end on risk breaches and episode_equity.csv is written at training end. Final train/test reports remain authoritative for full-split evaluation and survival.
status: bounded protocol audit; active 20M campaign is incomplete

training_budget.interpretation: 20M PPO timesteps are aggregate across 64 vector environments. The nominal budget can cover about 3.16 full NY-session traversals per environment if episodes reach the end of the training split. Guardrail breaches terminate episodic training episodes early, so this ratio is capacity, not observed coverage.

training_data.count_method: Count rows in the hashed raw M1 file with date <= 2025-12-31 and clock time 16:30 through 23:00 inclusive; this matches quant_rl/data/session.py session labeling and TradingEnv bundle NY-session indexing.
